mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at City Hall are 69 degrees under clear skies. We are in a First Quarter moon phase, and if you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible for three minutes starting at 4:10 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, where it will soar almost directly overhead. We expect an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20, 2026. Additionally, the city has implemented a rain barrel rebate program, offering 30 dollars back for property owners who install a 35-gallon barrel to help with stormwater management.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.

On Friday, August 15, Verona police officers responded to a call regarding a 7-year-old missing child in the Westridge Estates neighborhood, who was thankfully found and safely reunited with their parents shortly after.
The flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor changes to Chocolate Heath Crunch.
